title: Nebula Solo #011 (에메랄드 성운 · 체형 super hourglass · 인종 blue-black · 메이크업 푸시아 립 강함 · 배경 앙코르와트 회랑(흐린 낮) · 힐 40인치 · 몸 주얼리)

Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Dense cosmic surface — BLAZING deep emerald-green and sapphire-blue nebula clouds across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID tiny white and pale-gold stars and thin pale-gold constellation lines linking the brightest stars, softly glowing, completely opaque, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Background: the carved stone galleries of Angkor Wat with sunlit sandstone paving, standard-height doorways and low stone steps, empty of tourists, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
